cases.question_en: How many work orders have each status?
cases.question_de: Wie viele Arbeitsaufträge gibt es je Status?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS work_order_count FROM work_orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS work_order_count FROM [demo].work_orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

cases.question_en: Which five assets have the most recorded downtime from resolved failures?
cases.question_de: Welche fünf Anlagen haben die meiste erfasste Ausfallzeit aus behobenen Störungen?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT e.asset_code, SUM(f.downtime_minutes) AS downtime_minutes FROM equipment e JOIN failure_events f ON f.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE f.downtime_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.asset_code ORDER BY downtime_minutes DESC, e.asset_code LIMIT 5
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT TOP (5) e.asset_code, SUM(f.downtime_minutes) AS downtime_minutes FROM [demo].equipment e JOIN [demo].failure_events f ON f.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE f.downtime_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.asset_code ORDER BY downtime_minutes DESC, e.asset_code

cases.question_en: How many recorded labor minutes did each site spend on work orders completed in September 2026?
cases.question_de: Wie viele erfasste Arbeitsminuten entfielen je Standort auf im September 2026 abgeschlossene Aufträge?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT s.site_name, SUM(w.labor_minutes) AS labor_minutes FROM sites s JOIN equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE w.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00' AND w.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT s.site_name, SUM(w.labor_minutes) AS labor_minutes FROM [demo].sites s JOIN [demo].equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN [demo].work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE w.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00' AND w.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name

cases.question_en: As of 1 October 2026 at 00:00 UTC, how many open or in-progress orders are overdue at each site?
cases.question_de: Wie viele offene oder laufende Aufträge sind je Standort am 1. Oktober 2026 um 00:00 UTC überfällig?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT s.site_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_orders FROM sites s JOIN equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE w.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND w.due_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT s.site_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_orders FROM [demo].sites s JOIN [demo].equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN [demo].work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE w.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND w.due_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name

cases.question_en: Which assets have no recorded failure events?
cases.question_de: Welche Anlagen haben keine erfassten Störungen?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT e.asset_code FROM equipment e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM failure_events f WHERE f.equipment_id=e.equipment_id) ORDER BY e.asset_code
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT e.asset_code FROM [demo].equipment e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [demo].failure_events f WHERE f.equipment_id=e.equipment_id) ORDER BY e.asset_code

cases.question_en: What is the recorded parts cost in euro cents for completed work orders at each site?
cases.question_de: Wie hoch sind die erfassten Ersatzteilkosten in Eurocent für abgeschlossene Aufträge je Standort?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT s.site_name, SUM(wp.quantity * wp.unit_cost_eur_cents) AS parts_cost_eur_cents FROM sites s JOIN equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id JOIN work_order_parts wp ON wp.work_order_id=w.work_order_id WHERE w.status='completed' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT s.site_name, SUM(wp.quantity * wp.unit_cost_eur_cents) AS parts_cost_eur_cents FROM [demo].sites s JOIN [demo].equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN [demo].work_orders w ON w.equipment_id=e.equipment_id JOIN [demo].work_order_parts wp ON wp.work_order_id=w.work_order_id WHERE w.status='completed' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name

cases.question_en: Which five assigned technicians completed the most work orders?
cases.question_de: Welche fünf zugewiesenen Techniker haben die meisten Aufträge abgeschlossen?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT t.display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM technicians t JOIN work_orders w ON w.technician_id=t.technician_id WHERE w.status='completed' GROUP BY t.display_name ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, t.display_name LIMIT 5
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT TOP (5) t.display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM [demo].technicians t JOIN [demo].work_orders w ON w.technician_id=t.technician_id WHERE w.status='completed' GROUP BY t.display_name ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, t.display_name

cases.question_en: What is mean active repair time in minutes for resolved failures, grouped by failure mode?
cases.question_de: Wie hoch ist die mittlere aktive Reparaturzeit in Minuten je Störungsart für behobene Störungen?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT failure_mode, COUNT(*) AS resolved_failures, ROUND(AVG(CAST(repair_minutes AS FLOAT)), 2) AS mttr_minutes FROM failure_events WHERE repair_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY failure_mode ORDER BY failure_mode
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT failure_mode, COUNT(*) AS resolved_failures, ROUND(AVG(CAST(repair_minutes AS FLOAT)), 2) AS mttr_minutes FROM [demo].failure_events WHERE repair_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY failure_mode ORDER BY failure_mode

cases.question_en: How many maintenance plans are due at each site from 1 October through 7 October 2026 UTC?
cases.question_de: Wie viele Wartungspläne sind je Standort vom 1. bis einschließlich 7. Oktober 2026 UTC fällig?
cases.sql_sqlite: SELECT s.site_name, COUNT(*) AS plans_due FROM sites s JOIN equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN maintenance_plans m ON m.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE m.next_due_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00' AND m.next_due_at < '2026-10-08T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name
cases.sql_sqlserver: SELECT s.site_name, COUNT(*) AS plans_due FROM [demo].sites s JOIN [demo].equipment e ON e.site_id=s.site_id JOIN [demo].maintenance_plans m ON m.equipment_id=e.equipment_id WHERE m.next_due_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00' AND m.next_due_at < '2026-10-08T00:00:00' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY s.site_name
